title: Coin Change II
summary: Count the different combinations of coins that add up to an amount, with unlimited coins of each value.

tests.explain: Coins of 2 only make even amounts.
There is exactly one way to make 0: use no coins.

hints: Order doesn't matter: 1 + 2 and 2 + 1 are the same combination. A loop that tries every coin as the 'last coin' for every amount counts them twice.
Process the coins one at a time. ways[a] = number of combinations of the coins seen so far that make a. Adding a coin c: ways[a] += ways[a - c].
Put the coin loop OUTSIDE and the amount loop inside, going UP from c to amount (a coin may be used again). Start with ways[0] = 1.

complexity.time: O(amount × number of coins): every coin updates every amount once
